definitions: To be carried by the movement of air.
To be revealed or exposed, often unexpectedly.
To be utterly surprised or impressed.
To be destroyed or damaged by an explosion.
To be exhausted or out of breath.
examples: The leaves were blown across the yard.
Their cover was blown during the mission.
I was blown away by her performance.
The bridge was blown up by the rebels.
After the run, he was completely blown.
